title: 第11章 日冕第12章 该喝药了
slug: 军事公主不会爱上魔法科学家
lines: 山顶。
六阶魔弓手法尔克猛的回头，怎么过来的？！
他从没听说过什么空间术式能无前摇的一次传送几公里！
但法尔克到底是身经百战的强者，身体的反应快过了大脑。
他没有后退，反而狞笑着从腰间拔出淬毒的附魔短刀，反手捅向洛加里斯的心脏。
“蠢货，你以为我只会射箭吗？找死！”
可洛加里斯的反应更快，他身上那件漆黑研究长袍下，一道道银色金属纹路瞬间亮了起来。
嗡！
一套银白色的全身魔导装甲凭空出现，将他完全覆盖。
装甲表面刻着复杂的金色纹路，正是第五代魔导装甲，“正义”。
刚才对付莉莉丝不敢拿出来，现在终于可以倾力使用。
不，那并非金铁交鸣的脆响，而是一声沉闷的能量嗡鸣。
法尔克的附魔短刀结结实实刺在装甲胸口，受击点的金色纹路骤然亮起，一个微型斥力场瞬间展开，将短刀上蕴含的巨力弭于无形。
别说伤口，就连一道白痕都没留下。
“这什么鬼东西？！”
法尔克悚然一惊，饶是以他的见识，也没认出来眼前这玩意是什么。
洛加里斯根本没理他，抬起覆盖着装甲的右手，一发【裂解弹】瞬间成型。
法尔克浑身汗毛倒竖，想也不想，就地一个狼狈的翻滚。
轰！
裂解弹打在远处的岩石上。
那块马车大小的岩石，竟无声无息的消失了，被直接分解成了最基础的以太微粒。
法尔克看着岩石消失的地方，只觉得后背一阵发凉。
他迅速拉开距离，再次搭弓，一口气射出三发追踪光箭，成品字形封死了洛加里斯所有闪避的路线。
洛加里斯却静静站在原地，甚至没抬手。
三支光箭呼啸而至，命中他身体的瞬间，竟诡异的直接穿了过去，没有造成任何伤害。
【洛加里斯式·相位偏转护盾】。
法尔克眼珠子都快瞪出来了。
这是什么魔法？空间扭曲？
他完全看不懂！
不等他想明白，洛加里斯已经抬起了手。
天空一暗。
三颗直径超过五十米的奥术流星，拖着长长的焰尾，从三个方向朝着法尔克的位置狠狠的砸下！
“多重施法？！”
法尔克不再迟疑，将速度爆发到极致，如同一道在山巅之上急速穿梭的鬼魅。他的身影在岩石间、在峭壁上、在每一个可以落脚的瞬间腾挪跳跃，试图摆脱流星的锁定。
一时间，山顶上轰鸣不断，法尔克的身影在火光与烟尘中时隐时现。
山下的平原。
反魔少女莉莉丝看着疾冲而来的瑟薇娅，感觉有点牙疼。
content_en:
Mountain top.
The sixth-level magic archer Falke turned his head sharply, how did he get here? !
He has never heard of any space spell that can teleport several kilometers at a time without moving forward!
But after all, Falk is a strong man who has experienced hundreds of battles, and his body's reaction is faster than that of his brain.
He did not retreat, but instead pulled out the poison-enchanted short knife from his waist with a grin, and stabbed Logaris in the heart with his backhand.
"Idiot, do you think I can only shoot arrows? I'm looking for death!"
But Logaris reacted faster. Under the dark research robe on his body, the silver metal lines lit up instantly.
Buzz!
A set of silver-white full-body magic armor appeared out of thin air, covering him completely.
The surface of the armor is engraved with complex golden patterns, which is the fifth generation magic armor, "Justice".
I didn't dare to use it against Lilith just now, but now I can finally use it with all my strength.
clang! ——
No, that was not the crisp sound of gold and iron, but a dull hum of energy.
Falk's enchanted dagger stabbed firmly into the chest of the armor. The golden lines at the point of impact suddenly lit up, and a miniature repulsive force field instantly unfolded, wiping out the huge power contained in the dagger.
Not to mention wounds, not even a white mark was left.
"What the hell is this?!"
Falk was horrified. Even with his knowledge, he didn't recognize what the thing in front of him was.
Logaris ignored him at all, raised his armor-covered right hand, and a [Fragmentation Bomb] was instantly formed.
The hair all over Falk's body stood on end, and without thinking, he rolled on the spot in embarrassment.
boom!
Fragmentation rounds hit the rocks in the distance.
The rock, which was the size of a carriage, disappeared silently and was directly broken down into the most basic ether particles.
Falk looked at the place where the rock disappeared and felt a chill on his back.
He quickly distanced himself, nocked his bow again, and fired three tracking light arrows in one go. The finished glyph blocked all Logaris' dodge routes.
Logaris stood quietly, not even raising his hand.
Three light arrows whizzed towards him, and the moment they hit his body, they strangely passed through without causing any damage.
[Logaris Style·Phase Deflection Shield].
Falk's eyes almost popped out of his head.
What kind of magic is this? Space distortion?
He couldn't understand it at all!
Before he could figure it out, Logaris had already raised his hand.
The sky darkened.
Three arcane meteors with a diameter of more than fifty meters, dragging long flame tails, slammed down towards Falk's position from three directions!
"Multicast?!"
Falk no longer hesitated and exploded to the extreme speed, like a ghost speeding across the top of the mountain. His figure jumped among the rocks, on the cliffs, and at every moment where he could settle down, trying to escape from the lock of the meteor.
For a time, there was a constant roar on the top of the mountain, and Falk's figure appeared and disappeared in the firelight and smoke.
…
The plain below the mountain.
The anti-magic girl Lilith felt a bit toothache when she looked at Serviya rushing towards her.
